verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims 'Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation,' which is first-party but only a one-line marketing mention of the story's core. The MCP plugin documents the app acting as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients, which covers agents getting consented tokens for your own app, not for third-party APIs. missing for 10: documented token vault for stored third-party provider tokens, documented token-exchange flow details, short-lived delegated token issuance for external APIs, user-consent flow for agent delegation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
